body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Akasa(www.akasa.com.tw) presented its aluminium notebook cooler 'AK-NBC-07' at the CES 2009.

Notebooks and MacBooks can get very warm and while stock cooling is usually adequate to prevent the notebook from overheating adding effective cooling under the laptop significantly decreases overall system temperature. This keeps the noise level of internal system fans to a minimum providing a quieter working environment, extends life of computer components and enhances cooling performance when the notebook is on 100% load.
